goal.note: A directional ambition, not a promised outcome or quality metric.

stages.label: Proof and activation
stages.primary_outcome: Ten reproducible external builds and a searchable Agent Skills listing
stages.gate: Do not scale promotion until a stranger can discover, install, invoke, and share a result without maintainer help.

stages.label: Category ownership
stages.primary_outcome: Own the non-designer UI judgment problem through recurring public evidence
stages.gate: At least five third-party artifacts and two independent workflow comparisons must be public.

stages.label: Community flywheel
stages.primary_outcome: Contributors and creators publish builds without direct maintainer prompting
stages.gate: Contribution, showcase, and support paths must work without private coordination.

stages.label: Ecosystem distribution
stages.primary_outcome: Become a default recommendation across agent-skill directories and creator workflows
stages.gate: Distribution partnerships must be earned through usage evidence, not reciprocal promotion.

stages.label: 10K stewardship
stages.primary_outcome: Protect trust, compatibility, and contributor experience at ecosystem scale
stages.gate: Growth never overrides safety, evidence, licensing, or maintainability.
